POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2024
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

Sarah Bedy, Member  Doug Killion, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 2:03 p.m., chair Sarah Bedy called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55825  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee meeting of
  Monday, November 18, 2024.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

2.  24-55826  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Clean Sweeps Public
  Works transfer cost opportunity with Homeless Services Staff.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4 Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Page 1 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2024
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Lewis

  • The subcommittee would like to target preventative and hygiene measures
  by reallocating the public works/ clean team resources.
  • No updates from staff at the moment.
  • Members of the subcommittee discussed incorporating environmental
  cleanups as a way to increase funding and a collaboration with the office of
  sustainability.
  • A member of the public had a question pertaining to storage lockers being
  available for the unhoused during cleanups.

3.  24-55827  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the potential visit to 1955
  Long Beach Boulevard to gain further insight into the services offered at MHALA’s
  Integrated Service Center.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

  • Chair Sarah Bedy gave an update on her recent visit to the MHALA
  site. Additionally, MHALA has entered a contract with the VA to offer
  services and will be operating from 9:00 AM to 5 PM the site
  includes bathrooms and showers designated exclusively for veterans.
  • The subcommittee plans to revisit the site in a few months once the projects
  are up and running.

4.  24-55828  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the City of Long Beach’s 2025
  goals to increasing shelter beds and rates.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  Page 2 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2024
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  Absent:  1 Lewis

  • The subcommittee would like to know how they can be part of the strategic
  plan.
  • Members of the subcommittee requested detailed information on the
  availability of shelter beds, the various types of shelters, the number of
  individuals on the waitlist, and expressed a desire to work om creating
  projections for future housing needs.
  • A member of the public inquired about how to access the meeting minutes.

5.  24-55829  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the planned outreach
  initiatives and programs specifically targeted at older adults experiencing
  homelessness.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

  • This item will be carried over to the next subcommittee meeting.

6.  24-55830  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

  • Members of the subcommittee suggested items for future meetings,
  including the city’s RFP process, The Point-In Time Count and winter shelter.
  • A member of the public had a concern about the City budget
  addressing homelessness in the city of Long Beach.

  Page 3 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2024
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  • Chair Sarah Bedy provided an update on her visit to the MHALA site and the discussed the
  challenges they face in opening an access center due to high operational expenses.
  • MHALA has signed a contract with the VA to provide bathroom and shower access to Veterans
  only. The subcommittee would like to recommend better use of funding be made available for
  a drop-in center.
  • The subcommittee plans to revisit MHALA once they are actively running projects.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • A member of the public inquired about whether winter shelter is already open.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • No announcements.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Sarah Bedy, adjourns the meeting at 2:58 p.m.
